description: Sort rows by one or more columns.
source: Example Workflows\Customer Intelligence\Credit Scoring\Building a Credit Scoring Model\Sorter (#52)\settings.xml

params.name: columns
params.description: Columns to sort by, in order.

params.name: descending
params.description: true/false per column (false = ascending). Auto-fills with false when omitted; must match columns length.

params.name: alphanumeric
params.description: true = alphanumeric (natural) string order, per column. Auto-fills with false when omitted.

params.name: missing_to_end
params.description: Sort missing values to the end.
